usageNotes: Returns the list of QEMU Guest Agent (QGA) sub-commands available for a running VM. Use this as a discovery step before calling specific agent sub-commands (e.g., get-fsinfo, get-network-interfaces) to confirm which commands the installed QGA version supports. The VM must be running and the qemu-guest-agent service must be active inside the guest; if the agent is not running the response will be empty or the request will fail.

examples.summary: List available guest agent commands for VM 101 on node pve01

tips: An empty result array means the guest agent is installed but not running, or the VM is powered off.
Child links in the response (rel: child) map directly to callable sub-endpoints under /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/agent/{name}.
Guest agent must be enabled in the VM config (agent: enabled=1) and the qemu-guest-agent package installed inside the OS.
